minecraft_block.description: a few small dark-gray cube fragments at t3: one gray square floating in the sky and two small clusters of blocky gray chunks on the grass in front and threequarter views; in top t3 a gray cube sits next to the brown dirt pile. nothing visible at t8 or t20 in any angle.
minecraft_block.notes: very few pixels; the airborne cube is clearly non-grass but fragments are small

minecraft_crimson_spore.description: about ten tiny red-pink square specks scattered across the upper sky at t3 in front view, a few more at threequarter t3; essentially nothing at t8 or t20; top row shows only dirt debris.
minecraft_crimson_spore.notes: each speck is only a few pixels; easy to miss against sky

minecraft_dripping_obsidian_tear.description: a small fixed cluster of about five dark-purple square droplets hovering in the sky, identical position in every front and threequarter cell (t3, t8, t20) - a continuously emitting drip point; nothing in top view besides dirt debris.
minecraft_dripping_obsidian_tear.notes: unchanged across ticks suggests continuous emitter rather than a burst

minecraft_enchant.description: tiny pale-gray specks in the sky at front t3 and threequarter t3; in top t8 several small white-lavender angular glyph-like marks (short bars, l-shapes, dots) are scattered on the grass among the dirt debris; all other cells empty.
minecraft_enchant.notes: glyph marks only clearly readable in top t8; could be mistaken for debris at a glance

minecraft_falling_lava.description: small clusters of orange droplet specks in the sky at front and threequarter t3 and t8; in top t8 bright orange horizontal streaks/dashes lie among the brown dirt chunks; a single faint red speck remains at threequarter t20.
minecraft_falling_lava.notes: top-view orange streaks could be confused with dirt debris but are distinctly brighter orange

minecraft_glow_squid_ink.description: a bright cyan-teal glowing splat cluster sitting on the horizon line in front t3 and threequarter t3 - an irregular blobby patch roughly 40-60px across; completely gone by t8 in all angles; top row shows only dirt debris.
minecraft_glow_squid_ink.notes: clearly visible but very short-lived; single capture tick only

minecraft_item_slime.description: one small mint-lime green cube resting on the grass in front t3, plus a tiny dark-green speck at threequarter t3 and a faint pale speck at front t8; everything else empty; top row shows only dirt debris.
minecraft_item_slime.notes: the green cube nearly blends with grass; could be an item-icon particle

minecraft_ominous_spawning.description: three to five very faint pale-blue dots in the upper sky at front t3 and threequarter t3; nothing at t8, t20, or in top view beyond dirt debris.
minecraft_ominous_spawning.notes: only a handful of pixels; borderline against compression noise

minecraft_shriek.description: a thin pale-cyan elliptical ring outline at the very top edge of the front t3 frame, partially cut off by the frame border; nothing else in any cell; top row shows only dirt debris.

scale_impression: large ring, mostly out of frame

minecraft_shriek.notes: ring is clipped by the top of the frame so only a sliver is visible

minecraft_splash.description: a vertical spray of small blue droplet specks rising into the sky at front t3, with a few blue dots also in threequarter t3; nothing at t8 or t20; top row shows only dirt debris.
minecraft_splash.notes: classic droplet-spray silhouette but only ~20 specks total

minecraft_vibration.description: every cell is identical to the empty baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, and in top view only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile. no particles or marks of any color at any tick or angle.
possible_roles: nothing usable observed - possibly invisible effect or capture miss
minecraft_vibration.notes: vibration particles may be too small/subtle or the effect did not fire

world_event_ANIMATION_TRIAL_SPAWNER_EJEC.description: a burst of black smoke specks mixed with orange-yellow teardrop-shaped flame particles clustered in the upper sky at front t3; a few small yellow-orange sparks linger at front t8 and two tiny yellow bits at threequarter t8; gone by t20; top row shows only dirt debris.
world_event_ANIMATION_TRIAL_SPAWNER_EJEC.notes: mixed black smoke plus flame sprites reads as an ejection/explosion pop

world_event_PARTICLES_DRAGON_FIREBALL_SP.description: a scatter of magenta and purple star-shaped sparkle specks across the upper sky at front t3, a few visible at threequarter t3; sparse faint dots remain at t8 and almost nothing at t20; top row shows only dirt debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_DRAGON_FIREBALL_SP.notes: spread across a wide sky area, consistent with a splash burst

world_event_PARTICLES_SHOOT_WHITE_SMOKE.description: every cell is identical to the empty baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, and in top view only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile. no white smoke or any other particles at any tick or angle.
possible_roles: nothing usable observed - possibly invisible effect or capture miss
world_event_PARTICLES_SHOOT_WHITE_SMOKE.notes: expected white smoke but none rendered in any cell

world_event_PARTICLES_WATER_EVAPORATING.description: a small cluster of white-cream puff specks at the top edge of the sky in front t3; in top t3 a large irregular black soot-like splat cluster covers a patch of ground next to and partly over the brown dirt pile; everything gone by t8; top t8/t20 show only debris.

brightness: very dark splats plus pale wisps

world_event_PARTICLES_WATER_EVAPORATING.notes: the big black ground patch might be a shadow or decal rather than particles; white wisps at front t3 are clearly particles

superheroes_fula_particle.description: a cluster of white curly spiral/cloud-shaped wisps at the top edge of the sky in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8, still faintly present at t20; nothing in top view besides dirt debris.
superheroes_fula_particle.notes: distinctive spiral curl texture; persists near the frame top so partly clipped

superheroes_homelander_laser_impact.description: every cell is identical to the empty baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, and in top view only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile. no beam, flash, sparks, or scorch marks at any tick or angle.
possible_roles: nothing usable observed - possibly invisible effect or capture miss
superheroes_homelander_laser_impact.notes: no impact flash at all; the effect may have fired off-camera or failed to spawn

superheroes_moonveil.description: two small clusters of violet-blue star-shaped sparkle specks in the upper sky at front t3 and threequarter t3, still clearly visible at t8, shrinking to a couple of faint specks at t20; nothing in top view besides dirt debris.

persistence: t3 to t8, faint at t20

superheroes_moonveil.notes: clean two-cluster symmetry suggests a structured emitter

superheroes_scorpion_teleport.description: front and top cells are baseline empty; the only marks anywhere are two small brown dirt chunks at the bottom edge of threequarter t8, matching the persistent dirt-debris background, not an effect.
possible_roles: nothing usable observed - possibly invisible effect or capture miss
superheroes_scorpion_teleport.notes: two brown chunks at threequarter t8 match the debris-pile look; teleport flash may have missed the capture ticks

vfxlab_ember_ring_burst.description: at front t3 an open elliptical ring of red-orange ember dots sits at the top of the frame, expanding into a wider dispersed arc of red-orange and pink sparks at front t8; a few red dots peek over the top edge of threequarter t8; gone by t20; top row shows only dirt debris.
vfxlab_ember_ring_burst.notes: clean ring geometry; sits high in the sky and partially clips the frame top
